<p>
<b>Subject: </b>PECOS Termination- Denial Letter
</p>

<p>
Dear [[Name]]:
</p>
<p>
The Ohio Department of Medicaid (ODM) has learned that your status with the Center for Medicare and Medicaid has been revoked or is no longer active.  As a result of this status, ODM is required to terminate your Ohio Medicaid Program Agreement or deny your application in accordance with Ohio Administration Code (OAC) 5160-1-17.6 (I)(5).   </p>
<p>You are hereby notified that your provider agreement with the ODM is terminated or your application has been denied.  Ohio law affords no appeal of this action pursuant to Chapter 119 of the Revised Code.  (See OAC 5160-70-02.)  If you disagree with this termination or denial, you may request an administrative review pursuant to OAC 5160-70-02.  If you wish an administrative review, please send a written request including all information that you consider relevant to this action to :</p>

<div style="text-align:center"><b>
Office of the Director <br/ >
Ohio Department of Medicaid<br/ >
PO Box 182709<br/ >
Columbus, Ohio 43218-2709<br/ >
</b></div>

<p style="page-break-before: always;">If you require additional information or assistance, please contact Provider Enrollment Customer Service  at 800-686-1516.</p>
Sincerely,<br />
    <br />
Ohio Medicaid Provider Compliance
</td>
